1.text: Uhereye uwo munsi hāduka akarengane gakomeye mu Itorero ry'i Yerusalemu, bose batatanira mu bihugu by'i Yudaya n'i Samariya, keretse intumwa.

2.text: Abantu bubahaga Imana bahamba Sitefano, baramuborogera cyane.

3.text: Ariko Sawuli we akomeza guca igikuba mu Itorero no kuryonona cyane, akinjira mu mazu yose agafata abagabo n'abagore, akabakurubana mu nzu y'imbohe.

4.text: Nuko abatatanye bajya hose, bamamaza ijambo ry'Imana.

5.text: Filipo aramanuka ajya mu mudugudu w'i Samariya, ababwiriza ibya Kristo.

6.text: Ab'aho benshi baraterana, bumva ibyo Filipo avuga n'umutima uhuye bamwitayeho, bumvise kandi babonye ibimenyetso yakoraga.

7.text: Kuko benshi muri bo bari bafite abadayimoni babavamo basakuza cyane, n'abari baremaye n'abacumbagira benshi barakizwa.

8.text: Haba umunezero mwinshi muri uwo mudugudu.

9.text: Hariho umuntu w'umukonikoni witwaga Simoni wabaga muri uwo mudugudu, agatangaza ubwoko bw'Abasamariya akiyita ukomeye.

10.text: Baramwumvaga bamwitayeho bose, abakomeye n'aboroheje bati “Uyu muntu ni we Mbaraga y'Imana yitwa ikomeye.”

11.text: Icyatumaga bamwitaho, ni uko uhereye kera yajyaga abatangarisha iby'ubukonikoni bwe.

12.text: Ariko bamaze kwizera ubutumwa bwiza Filipo ababwira bw'ubwami bw'Imana n'ubw'izina rya Yesu Kristo, barabatizwa, abagabo n'abagore.

13.text: Na Simoni ubwe aremera, kandi amaze kubatizwa agumya kubana na Filipo. Abonye uburyo akora ibimenyetso n'imirimo ikomeye arumirwa.

14.text: Nuko intumwa zari i Yerusalemu zumvise yuko Abasamariya bemeye ijambo ry'Imana, zibatumaho Petero na Yohana,

15.text: na bo basohoyeyo barabasabira ngo bahabwe Umwuka Wera,

16.text: kuko hari hataragira n'umwe wo muri bo amanukira, ahubwo bari barabatijwe gusa mu izina ry'Umwami Yesu.

17.text: Nuko babarambikaho ibiganza, bahabwa Umwuka Wera.

18.text: Ariko Simoni abonye yuko abarambitsweho ibiganza by'intumwa bahabwa Umwuka Wera, azizanira ifeza

19.text: arazibwira ati “Nanjye nimumpe ubwo bubasha ngo uwo nzarambikaho ibiganza ahabwe Umwuka Wera.”

20.text: Petero aramubwira ati “Pfana ifeza yawe, kuko wagize ngo impano y'Imana iboneshwa ifeza.

21.text: Nta mugabane haba n'urutabe ufite muri byo, kuko umutima wawe udatunganiye Imana.

22.text: Nuko wihane ubwo bubi bwawe, usabe Umwami kugira ngo ahari niba bishoboka, ibyo wibwira mu mutima wawe ubibabarirwe.

23.text: Ndakureba uri mu birura no mu ngoyi zo gukiranirwa.”

24.text: Simoni aramusubiza ati “Munsabire Umwami, kugira ngo hatagira ikintu kimbaho mu byo muvuze.”

25.text: Na bo bamaze guhamya no kubwira abantu ijambo ry'Umwami, basubira i Yerusalemu babwiriza ubutumwa bwiza mu birorero byinshi by'Abasamariya.

26.text: Bukeye marayika w'Umwami Imana abwira Filipo ati “Haguruka ugane ikusi, ugere mu nzira imanuka iva i Yerusalemu ikajya i Gaza, ya yindi ica mu butayu.”

27.text: Arahaguruka aragenda. Nuko haza Umunyetiyopiya w'inkone, umutware n'umunyabyuma w'ibintu byose bya Kandake, umugabekazi w'Abanyetiyopiya. Yari yaragiye i Yerusalemu gusenga.

28.text: Yasubiragayo yicaye mu igare rye, asoma igitabo cy'umuhanuzi Yesaya.

29.text: Umwuka abwira Filipo ati “Sanga ririya gare ujyane na ryo.”

30.text: Filipo arirukanka yumva asoma igitabo cy'umuhanuzi Yesaya, aramubaza ati “Ibyo usoma ibyo urabyumva?”

31.text: Undi ati “Nabibasha nte ntabonye ubinsobanurira?” Yinginga Filipo ngo yurire bicarane.

32.text: Ibyo yasomaga mu byanditswe byari ibi ngo“Yajyanywe nk'intama bajyana mu ibagiro,Kandi nk'uko umwana w'intama ucecekera imbere y'uwukemura ubwoya,Ni ko atabumbuye akanwa ke.

33.text: Ubwo yacishwaga bugufi,Urubanza rwari rumukwiriye barumukuyeho.Umuryango we uzamenyekana ute?Ko ubugingo bwe bukuwe mu isi?”

34.text: Iyo nkone ibaza Filipo iti “Ndakwinginga mbwira, ayo magambo umuhanuzi yayavuze kuri nde? Yayivuzeho cyangwa yayavuze ku wundi?”

35.text: Filipo aterura amagambo, ahera kuri ibyo byanditswe amubwira ubutumwa bwiza bwa Yesu.

36.text: Bakigenda mu nzira bagera ku mazi, iyo nkone iramubaza iti “Dore amazi, ikimbuza kubatizwa ni iki?” [

37.text: Filipo arayisubiza ati “Niba wizeye mu mutima wawe wose birashoboka.” Na yo iti “Nizeye Yesu Kristo ko ari Umwana w'Imana.”]

38.text: Itegeka ko bahagarika igare, baramanukana bajya mu mazi bombi Filipo n'inkone, arayibatiza.

39.text: Bavuye mu mazi Umwuka w'Imana ajyana Filipo inkone ntiyasubira kumubona, nuko ikomeza kugenda inezerewe.

40.text: Ariko Filipo abonekera muri Azoto, agenda abwira abantu ubutumwa bwiza mu midugudu yose, kugeza aho yagereye i Kayisariya.
